races.paceDynamic: Tangara Bay will lead from flag to finish with no other confirmed front runners to pressure him early. Ned In The Park, Former Flame, Mic Drop and Strange Currency will track in behind but none are aggressive pace forcers. This creates a pedestrian gallop that builds gradually, with the real test coming from the final hurdle home over testing ground. This sustainable tempo heavily favours hold-up horses like Thisain'tthat, Paradise Lost, Spellacy's Cross and King Gris who can stay on strongly when others tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Tangara Bay sets modest fractions and the pace doesn't quicken until late.
scenarios.body: The testing ground and stamina-sapping finish expose the prominent runners who go too early. Strong stayers like Thisain'tthat and Paradise Lost come from the back to collar the leaders in the final 100 yards.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Tangara Bay maintains his kick turning for home and the closers leave their run too late.
scenarios.body: The De Bromhead gelding gets first run on his rivals and holds on grimly, while the hold-up horses find the sustained pace has stretched them beyond recovery. Ned In The Park stays on for place money.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Duo Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Former Flame or Strange Currency improve on recent form and travel strongly throughout.
scenarios.body: The Doyle and O'Loughlin runners use their tactical speed to strike approaching the final flight. They have enough in reserve to hold off late closers who are making up too much ground too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Improving Handicappers
scenarios.trigger: If King Gris or Spellacy's Cross reproduce their best recent form despite breaks.
scenarios.body: The Elliott and Barcoe charges benefit from strong stable form and tactical rides from top jockeys. Their class tells in a finish where everything comes together in a bunch from the last hurdle.

races.paceDynamic: Rusty Harkness and My Gaffer are both confirmed front runners who will clash from the start, creating an honest gallop over the extended trip. With both leaders having recent form concerns and likely to contest the pace, they may set it up perfectly for horses tracking behind. The sustained pace over 2m7f combined with the testing ground will expose any lacking stamina, while those held up can capitalize on the strong early gallop. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and those ridden prominently who can pick up the pieces when the early pace takes its toll.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If Rusty Harkness and My Gaffer engage in a pace battle from the start...
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will stretch the field and tire the leaders, allowing patient hold-up horses to strike late when others are stopping. Better Times, Ontheropes and Verdant Place can all capitalize on superior finishing kicks over this stamina-testing trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters maintain their duel beyond the 2-mile mark...
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will see them tie up in the final half-mile, creating opportunities for prominent racers who tracked the pace without engaging. Forceonmyown and Midnight Our Fred can benefit from their tactical positioning behind the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either Rusty Harkness or My Gaffer gets an uncontested lead...
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the survivor to control the race tempo and kick for home, making life difficult for hold-up horses on the testing ground. A controlled gallop would suit the leader's stamina reserves over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners lose their positions or pull up before halfway...
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with no genuine pace, turning into a sprint finish that could suit any horse positioned handy. This scenario would bring lightweight horses like Wakey Wakey Man and Rhythmic Tune into calculations.

races.paceDynamic: Single Edition is the only confirmed front runner in this 19-runner handicap hurdle and should get an uncontested lead early. With prominent runners like Baltinglass Hill and Glendine Billy likely to settle just behind, the pace will be sustainable rather than cutthroat. The large field and soft ground conditions will create a tactical affair where the pace may not truly quicken until after the final hurdle. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble early and deliver late kick on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate late
scenarios.trigger: If Single Edition sets a moderate pace and the field stays bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The sustainable early gallop allows closers to position perfectly before unleashing finishing kicks in the final 2f. Multiple hold-up horses can get competitive as the early pace-setters weaken on the soft ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners control
scenarios.trigger: If Baltinglass Hill and Glendine Billy press Single Edition from early
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and prevents the hold-up brigade from closing effectively. Horses tracking the pace get first run and maintain their advantage to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If Single Edition gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear after the last
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to save enough energy for a decisive move. By the time closers respond, Single Edition has built an unassailable advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos creates surprise winner
scenarios.trigger: If the large field causes significant interference or multiple fallers at hurdles
scenarios.body: The disruption eliminates several fancied runners and allows an outsider positioned perfectly to capitalize. A horse avoiding trouble becomes the beneficiary of others' misfortune.

races.paceDynamic: Pinot Gris will take them along from the front with Son Of Anarchy likely to track closely in second, creating a steady gallop over this sharp trip. The prominent runners will control the tempo without serious early pressure, allowing the pace to build gradually through the race. With limited early speed and most hold-up horses needing to navigate traffic in a small field, this sets up perfectly for the forward runners. The race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those able to sit handy, while hold-up horses face a significant tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Forward Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Pinot Gris and Son Of Anarchy control the pace without serious challenge from midfield.
scenarios.body: The front two can dictate terms and kick clear approaching the last, with their class and tactical advantage proving decisive. Hold-up horses are left with too much to do as the pace quickens late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly run throughout with multiple prominent runners pressing.
scenarios.body: The strong gallop finds out the stamina reserves and Royal Hollow's class can shine through as others tire. Forward runners maintain an edge but the best stayer can close late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Chase Inexperience Costs
scenarios.trigger: If multiple runners make jumping errors or get outpaced by the tempo changes.
scenarios.body: The most accomplished jumper or luckiest runner benefits from others' mistakes in this beginners' event. Pure ability matters less than a clear round and good positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Pinot Gris goes too slow early and bunches the field for a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The race turns into a tactical affair where the best turn of foot wins from any position. This unlikely scenario would suit the highest-rated hurdler with natural speed.

Pinot Gris might go too fast early given front-running style and need to prove himself for new connections
Royal Hollow's settling given she can race keenly - needs to relax to use her superior hurdles class
Son Of Anarchy's fitness after 71-day break, though Elliott stable generally gets them ready
Ground conditions deteriorating through card could particularly impact Nytol and Mercury Mission who prefer good ground

runners_data.spotlight: Course bumper winner; 1-6 over hurdles and rated 120; rated 7lb lower over fences after three chase runs; 7.5l behind Littlefoot at Downpatrick on latest and 10lb better off now so should get closer; place chance.

runners_data.name: Coral River

runners_data.spotlight: 2-7 over hurdles and rated 120;  yet to win in nine starts over the bigger obstacles, his best effort a 3.25l third in a 2m2f handicap chase at Galway (soft); well beaten over timber at Fairyhouse when last seen in November; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Ad Caelum
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with no wins over fences and pulled up last time, needs significant improvement
runners_data.comment: 0-10 over fences, yet to get to closer than 11l to the winner in chases, others preferred

races.paceDynamic: Coral River is the only confirmed front runner and will take them along at a sustainable gallop without pressure in the early stages. The Great Nudie and Nas Na Riogh are the likely prominent trackers, but neither has the pace to hassle Coral River early. This leaves the hold-up brigade of Littlefoot, Great Universe, Kamikaz Du Plessis and Ad Caelum with plenty of work to do from off the pace. The lack of genuine pace pressure early strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without effort.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Coral River maintains a strong gallop and isn't headed turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Coral River to dictate terms and kick clear when the pace lifts, with The Great Nudie best placed to chase but unable to peg back the leader. Hold-up horses face an impossible task from too far back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If The Great Nudie or Nas Na Riogh can get competitive with Coral River approaching the last
scenarios.body: The De Bromhead-trained Nas Na Riogh has the class edge and could benefit from Coral River's pace-setting efforts, while The Great Nudie showed her best form at this trip on soft ground. Both are better positioned than the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint from the last fence
scenarios.body: Littlefoot's recent winning form over fences and Great Universe's hold-up style could pay dividends if they can close the gap in time. However, they need significant pace collapse to be effective from their likely positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to fire and connections prove decisive
scenarios.body: Kamikaz Du Plessis has Jack Kennedy aboard and Gordon Elliott's 14-day strike rate provides hope, while the lack of pace could suit his hold-up style more than expected. This requires multiple failures from better-positioned rivals.

The Great Nudie's prominent style could be crucial if she can pressure Coral River early

runners_data.name: Gortnaclea Castle

runners_data.spotlight: Diamond Boy filly; half-sister to winners Butch (useful 2m4f-3m hurdle/chase), Eavesdropping (bumper and 2m3f/2m7f hurdle) and Hauraki Gulf (bumper and 2m5f/2m6f chase); dam unraced; makes a bit of appeal on paper so worth a market check.

runners_data.name: Thelittleballerina
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs pace to aim at, showed promise on debut third behind Gortnaclea Castle.
runners_data.comment: Pleasing run on debut at Down Royal, bred to stay and should improve, can't discount
runners_data.spotlight: Ran a pleasing race to finish a 3.75l third on debut at Down Royal last month, weakening late on (2l behind Gortnaclea Castle); should stay this far on breeding and she ought to improve for that initial experience; each-way shout.

runners_data.name: Tutu Twist
runners_data.note: Stayed on well over shorter trip on hurdles debut, step up in distance should suit hold-up style.
runners_data.comment: Placed in point, stayed on well over 2m in Naas maiden hurdle, farther will suit
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in one of two point-to-points; 16l third on Rules' debut in a Naas maiden hurdle (2m, sft-hvy), staying on well; interesting upped in trip in first bumper.

runners_data.name: Myluckymaker
runners_data.note: Raced too keenly last time, headgear change might help settle better for patient ride.
runners_data.comment: Backed at big odds last time but failed to deliver, likely capable of better than that
runners_data.spotlight: 80-1 when beaten 45l on debut at Fairyhouse; backed from 40-1 into 11-1 last time at Down Royal but raced keenly and finished in midfield behind a couple of these; probably capable of better.

runners_data.name: Isdistheone
runners_data.note: Multiple course experience but winless in eight bumper starts, form has declined recently.
runners_data.comment: Placed here over 2m in Nov', well below that level in five start since, needs more
runners_data.spotlight: 0-6 in bumpers; kept on nicely for a 5.25l third at this track in November (16.5f, soft); below best last five starts and was beaten 25l when fifth in a maiden hurdle here last time; needs more.

races.paceDynamic: Luciole Des Bordes is the only confirmed front-runner in this field and should dictate terms from the outset, likely getting an uncontested lead with the next prominent runner Gortnaclea Castle sitting just behind. With the majority of the field comprising hold-up horses (Thelittleballerina, Tutu Twist, Myluckymaker, Isdistheone), the pace will be moderate to steady early before quickening from the 3f pole. The lack of early pace pressure means Luciole Des Bordes can control the tempo and kick when ready, while prominent/pace-pressing horses will benefit from the controlled gallop and avoid being caught too far back in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Luciole Des Bordes gets soft fractions and times her kick perfectly.
scenarios.body: The Mullins-trained mare exploits her tactical advantage and superior class rating (OR 107) to put the race to bed before the hold-up horses can mount their challenge. Her prominent style perfectly suits a race where she can dictate without pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too slow and allows closers to unleash devastating late runs.
scenarios.body: Tutu Twist or Thelittleballerina benefit from the stamina test that emerges when the pace quickens late, with their proven staying power coming to the fore over this extended trip. The De Bromhead runner has shown she stays well when third over hurdles.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Debutant Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If either Giorgia Rose or On A Diamond brings significant improvement from their point-to-point experience.
scenarios.body: Giorgia Rose's point-to-point form translates well to this rules debut under Emmet Mullins' guidance, with the tongue-tie helping her settle better than in her pointing days. The extended absence becomes a positive as she arrives fresh and ready.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Luciole Des Bordes goes too fast early or fails to see out the trip strongly.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a true test of stamina where previous bumper experience counts for little and Isdistheone's multiple course runs give her the tactical know-how to pick up the pieces. Myluckymaker also benefits from the collapse of fancied runners ahead.
